summary: Scorpio Tankers filed a Form 6-K containing a routine operational update. It disclosed third-quarter 2026 average daily time charter equivalent (TCE) rates across vessel classes, with LR2 at $64,900/day pool/spot and $30,800/day time charter-out, and MR at $30,000/day pool/spot. It also announced time charter-out agreements for three product tankers: STI Gladiator ($40,188/day) and STI Jermyn ($42,500/day) for three years commencing September 2026, and STI Pontiac ($23,900/day) for three years commencing Q4 2026. These are ordinary commercial charter transactions, not a fundamental change in corporate structure. The filing also noted estimated diluted share counts including convertible debt dilution. There are no special-situation elements; the registrant remains a going concern in normal operations.
